# Punitdhan Pulses Limited

> India's premier manufacturer, processor, and bulk distributor of unpolished pulses, Chana Dal, Toor Dal, and agricultural grains since 1988.

## Main Pages & Documentation
- [Home & Corporate Overview](https://punitdhan.com/): Official portal of Punitdhan Pulses Limited, heritage since 1988, daily milling capacity of 400 MT.
- [Products & Technical Specifications](https://punitdhan.com/products-specs): Detailed technical specs, purity, grading, moisture levels, and packaging for Chana Dal, Toor Dal, Urad, Masoor, and Moong.
- [Institutional & Government Services](https://punitdhan.com/services): Government welfare supply (PDS, PMGKAY, Mid-Day Meal, ICDS) and defense canteen supply.
- [About Us & Heritage](https://punitdhan.com/about-us): 38+ years agricultural leadership founded by CA Prakashchand Bachhawat, Modasa mill milestone, and corporate profile.
- [Board of Directors & Governance](https://punitdhan.com/board-of-directors): Profiles of CA Prakashchand Bachhawat (Founder & MD) and CA Punit Bachhawat (Director & CFO).
- [Statutory Compliance & Alliances](https://punitdhan.com/alliances): Regulatory credentials including GSTIN 24AAPCP6070K1ZZ, PAN AAPCP6070K, FSSAI Licenses, ISO 9001:2015, and HACCP certifications.
- [Connect & Inquiry Desk](https://punitdhan.com/connect): Direct wholesale procurement channels, plant addresses, sales desks, and buyer support.
- [Careers & Opportunities](https://punitdhan.com/careers): Job openings in agritech, milling operations, supply chain logistics, and grain processing.

## Core Products
- [Chana Dal (Split Bengal Gram)](https://punitdhan.com/products-specs#chana-dal): Premium unpolished split chickpeas, high protein, low GI, cleaned with Sortex optical sorting.
- [Toor Dal (Pigeon Pea / Arhar Dal)](https://punitdhan.com/products-specs#toor-dal): Naturally dehusked yellow split pigeon peas, rich in dietary fiber and essential minerals.
- [Urad Dal & Whole Black Gram](https://punitdhan.com/products-specs#urad): Premium split washed and whole black gram for culinary and industrial food preparation.
- [Masoor Dal (Red Lentils)](https://punitdhan.com/products-specs#masoor): Fast-cooking polished/unpolished split red lentils packed with antioxidants and iron.
- [Moong Dal (Yellow Mung)](https://punitdhan.com/products-specs#moong): Easily digestible yellow split mung dal, rich in zinc and essential vitamins.
